description: Get mastery distribution analytics for outcomes in a course, optionally filtered by students or outcomes.

add_defaults.description: Include default mastery colors and levels when Canvas supports it.

exclude.description: Optional exclusions for missing users or missing outcome results.

include_alignment_distributions.description: Include contributing score distributions for alignments.

only_assignment_alignments.description: When including alignment distributions, limit them to assignments only.

outcome_ids.description: Optional outcome IDs to restrict the distribution results.

show_unpublished_assignments.description: Include unpublished assignments in alignment distributions.

student_ids.description: Optional Canvas student IDs (pass large IDs as strings) or SIS user IDs prefixed with "sis_user_id:".

name: get_outcome_mastery_distribution
title: Get Outcome Mastery Distribution
